newsitem.title: GREECE: Piraeus Bank goes ex-rights/ex-div May 23.
newsitem.headline: Piraeus Bank goes ex-rights/ex-div May 23.

text.p: Piraeus Bank obtained shareholder approval for a 15.8 billion drachma rights issue during its annual shareholders meeting on Thursday.

It will issue a total of 6,320,000 new shares at 2,500 drachmas a share. It will privately place 440,000 shares with staff at the same price. The subscription period will be announced at a later date.
The terms will be seven new shares for every 10 outstanding.
Shares of Piraeus Bank will trade ex-rights and ex-dividend on Friday May 23. The bank declared a dividend per share of 175 drachmas for fiscal 1996, up 47 percent on an adjusted basis.
Management told shareholders it expected pretax earnings growth of at least 50 percent this year based on first quarter performance.
It posted pretax profit of 3.2 billion drachmas in 1996. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
